notes.title: Update version 3.01
notes.content:
Misc

 Info button that explains how Wcoins and levels can be obtained

  10 games are now enough to reach level 2

 Added leveling bar that shows players progress

notes.title: Update version 1.11
notes.content:
General 

* S  command to call Goal Keeper removed from Match Making games
* Leveling up, team matches count double XP compared to Match Making matches
*  Fixed notification explaining why the game server closed

notes.title: Update version 1.9
notes.content:
Gameplay
*Slide delay after shooting affects only the player with the ball and not all players
*Goal Keeper will not wonder away from his area when someone uses "S"

User Interface
*Hattrick text removed
*Non-VIP players stats for small, medium and Large size revealed on the User Interface

notes.title: Update version 1.8
notes.content:
Match Making
* Players automatically kicked from the game server after match
* Players automatically kicked from the game lobby if there aren't 10 players
* Added notification explaining why the game closed

notes.title: Update version 1.6
notes.content:
Match Making
*Fixed bugs in previous update

W coins
*Players don't loose coins when they loose the match anymore
*Players get 1W per match in Match Making
*Players get 80W per 50 matches in  Team matches
*When a player leaves in the middle of a Match Making match and doesn't comeback right away, gets 2 coins penalty

notes.title: Update version 1.5
notes.content:
User Interface
*Buttons re-arranged 
*Visual minor changes

Match Making
*Players leaving lobby or the match will be automatically banned from MM for 15 minutes
*Players leaving the match will get points penalty
*Fixed exploit where if a full team leaves the match, it doesn't count
*If at least one player stays in-game, the match will count
*Added a double check panel after clicking Esc, before leaving a match

Team Matches
*Fixed bug where team stats were not counted in the team view
